complementary_credits_required: For the TITLE (RUCT 4314377, read directly from the register): 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos: 0'. notes: IMPORTANT — RUCT code identity. UPF holds TWO similarly named cognitive-systems titles in RUCT: 4310899 'Máster Universitario Interdisciplinario de los Media y Sistemas Cognitivos Interactivos', which is 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN A EXTINGUIR)' and is being wound down, and 4314377, the live title matching this programme name exactly. The correct code is 4314377; anyone matching on title similarity alone could easily land on the extinguishing 4310899 and wrongly conclude the programme is closing. Confirmed by reading the RUCT detail page for 4314377 directly. This title is NOT in output/ruct-detail.jsonl (it was not captured by the backbone's query terms) — it was found by running the RUCT script on the term 'cognitiv'.
